#!/bin/sh
# RVC Stage A v4 — built from the voice-clone SKILL recipe (2026-10-25).
# Fixes vs a3: TORCH_FORCE_NO_WEIGHTS_ONLY_LOAD=1 exported before any torch.load
# (RMVPE died on weights_only in a3); loud per-stage file-count checks.
export TORCH_FORCE_NO_WEIGHTS_ONLY_LOAD=1
ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)
REF="$ROOT/cloud-pc/storage/naruto-ref.flac"
[ -f "$REF" ] || REF="$ROOT/cloud-pc/storage/voices/naruto-ref.flac"
echo "REF=$REF"; ls -la "$REF" || { echo FAIL_REF; exit 1; }
cd $HOME && rm -rf rvc && git clone -q --depth 1 https://github.com/RVC-Project/Retrieval-based-Voice-Conversion-WebUI.git rvc || { echo FAIL_CLONE; exit 1; }
cd $HOME/rvc && echo CLONE_OK
# ffmpeg binary via imageio-ffmpeg (runner has none; RVC loads audio through it)
pip install -q imageio-ffmpeg || { echo FAIL_FFMPEG_PIP; exit 1; }
FF=$(python3 -c "import imageio_ffmpeg; print(imageio_ffmpeg.get_ffmpeg_exe())")
mkdir -p /tmp/ffbin && ln -sf "$FF" /tmp/ffbin/ffmpeg && export PATH=/tmp/ffbin:$PATH
ffmpeg -version | head -1 || { echo FAIL_FFMPEG; exit 1; }
# deps first (torch lines stripped), CPU torch LAST
sed -i '/^torch/d; /onnxruntime-gpu/d' requirements.txt 2>/dev/null || sed -i '' '/^torch/d' requirements.txt
pip install -q -r requirements.txt || { echo FAIL_DEPS; exit 1; }
pip install -q --force-reinstall torch torchaudio --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu || { echo FAIL_TORCH; exit 1; }
echo INSTALL_OK
# base models: hubert + rmvpe + v2 pretrained pair (for stage B seeding)
mkdir -p assets/hubert assets/rmvpe assets/pretrained_v2
curl -sL -o assets/hubert/hubert_base.pt https://huggingface.co/lj1995/VoiceConversionWebUI/resolve/main/hubert_base.pt
curl -sL -o assets/rmvpe/rmvpe.pt https://huggingface.co/lj1995/VoiceConversionWebUI/resolve/main/rmvpe.pt
curl -sL -o assets/pretrained_v2/f0G40k.pth https://huggingface.co/lj1995/VoiceConversionWebUI/resolve/main/pretrained_v2/f0G40k.pth
curl -sL -o assets/pretrained_v2/f0D40k.pth https://huggingface.co/lj1995/VoiceConversionWebUI/resolve/main/pretrained_v2/f0D40k.pth
ls -la assets/hubert/hubert_base.pt assets/rmvpe/rmvpe.pt || { echo FAIL_MODELS; exit 1; }
echo MODELS_OK
# dataset: convert ref to wav, hand to RVC preprocess (it slices)
mkdir -p $HOME/dataset && ffmpeg -y -v error -i "$REF" -ar 44100 $HOME/dataset/naruto_ref.wav || { echo FAIL_CONVERT; exit 1; }
EXP=naruto-en
export PYTHONPATH=$HOME/rvc
python3 -P infer/modules/train/preprocess.py $HOME/dataset 40000 2 $HOME/rvc/logs/$EXP False 3.0 2>&1 | tail -2
N_GT=$(ls logs/$EXP/0_gt_wavs 2>/dev/null | wc -l); echo "GT_WAVS=$N_GT"
[ "$N_GT" -gt 3 ] || { echo FAIL_PREPROCESS; exit 1; }
echo PREPROCESS_OK
# F0 extraction (RMVPE) — the step a3 died on; env fix is exported above
python3 -P infer/modules/train/extract/extract_f0_print.py cpu 2 $EXP rmvpe 2>&1 | tail -2 || \
python3 -P tools/extract_f0.py cpu $EXP 2 rmvpe 2>&1 | tail -2
N_F0=$(ls logs/$EXP/2a_f0 2>/dev/null | wc -l); echo "F0_FILES=$N_F0"
[ "$N_F0" -gt 3 ] || { echo FAIL_F0; exit 1; }
echo F0_OK
# HuBERT features
python3 -P infer/modules/train/extract/extract_hubert_feature.py cpu 1 0 $EXP v2 False 2>&1 | tail -2 || \
python3 -P tools/extract_hubert_feature.py cpu 1 0 $EXP v2 False 2>&1 | tail -2
N_FEAT=$(ls logs/$EXP/3_feature768 2>/dev/null | wc -l); echo "FEAT_FILES=$N_FEAT"
[ "$N_FEAT" -gt 3 ] || { echo FAIL_HUBERT; exit 1; }
echo HUBERT_OK
# filelist (recipe: intersection of gt/feature/f0/f0nsf + 2 mute lines) + v2 40k config
python3 - << 'PYEOF'
import os
exp = os.path.expanduser("~/rvc/logs/naruto-en")
gt = {os.path.splitext(f)[0] for f in os.listdir(f"{exp}/0_gt_wavs")}
feat = {os.path.splitext(f)[0] for f in os.listdir(f"{exp}/3_feature768")}
f0 = {os.path.splitext(f)[0] for f in os.listdir(f"{exp}/2a_f0")}
f0n = {os.path.splitext(f)[0] for f in os.listdir(f"{exp}/2b-f0nsf")}
names = sorted(gt & feat & f0 & f0n)
lines = [f"{exp}/0_gt_wavs/{n}.wav|{exp}/3_feature768/{n}.npy|{exp}/2a_f0/{n}.wav.npy|{exp}/2b-f0nsf/{n}.wav.npy|0" for n in names]
mute = os.path.expanduser("~/rvc/logs/mute")
for m in ("0_gt_wavs/mute40k.wav", "3_feature768/mute.npy", "2a_f0/mute.wav.npy", "2b-f0nsf/mute.wav.npy"):
    pass
lines.append(f"{mute}/0_gt_wavs/mute40k.wav|{mute}/3_feature768/mute.npy|{mute}/2a_f0/mute.wav.npy|{mute}/2b-f0nsf/mute.wav.npy|0")
lines.append(lines[-1])
open(f"{exp}/filelist.txt", "w").write("\n".join(lines))
import json, shutil
cfg = json.load(open(os.path.expanduser("~/rvc/configs/v2/40k.json")))
cfg["data"]["training_files"] = f"{exp}/filelist.txt"
json.dump(cfg, open(f"{exp}/config.json", "w"), indent=2)
print("FILELIST_ENTRIES", len(lines))
PYEOF
echo FILELIST_OK
tar -czf $HOME/stageA-naruto-en.tgz -C $HOME/rvc/logs naruto-en || { echo FAIL_TAR; exit 1; }
ls -la $HOME/stageA-naruto-en.tgz
RESP=$(curl -s -F "file=@$HOME/stageA-naruto-en.tgz" https://store1.gofile.io/contents/uploadfile)
echo "GOFILE_RESP=$RESP"
echo STAGE_A4_DONE
